Adapted from `TESTS/Plasticity/DruckerPragerYield.txt` with `Nx = Nz = 41`, `pwlv = 1` + `npwl = 3` to engage power-law creep (the DruckerPragerYield reference uses `cstv = 1` constant viscosity and is labelled "no creep, yield only"), `Newton = 1`, `lin_solver ∈ {0, 3}`, `user2 = 0` flagging the single-inclusion geometry for the §7 fixture setup wiring.)*
- [x] 3.4 Create `SETS/ShearBand/ConjugateBands_{gmg,chol}.txt` (two crossing shear bands, from task 11.8). *(Created at `TESTS/ShearBand/ConjugateBands_{gmg,chol}.txt`. Same numerical block as `SingleBand_{gmg,chol}.txt` with `user2 = 1` (conjugate-band geometry flag) and `user3 = 500` (inclusion offset in metres). The §7 setup will interpret `user2 = 1` as "two weak inclusions at ±(user3, user3)" so the pair's only geometric difference from SingleBand is the `user{2,3}` pair — any L2 difference vs the CHOLMOD twin must come from the band-geometry response alone, not a numerical-parameter drift.)*
- [x] 3.5 Create `SETS/AnalyticalBench/SolKz_{gmg,chol}.txt` (high-contrast SolKz for viscosity-variation convergence check). *(Created at `TESTS/AnalyticalBench/SolKz_{gmg,chol}.txt`. 51×51 unit square, `user0 = 8` sets the viscosity-contrast exponent B in η(z) = exp(2·B·z) (≈ 10⁷ contrast, widened `min_eta = 1e-8` / `max_eta = 1e8` cutoffs to avoid clipping), `user1 = 1.0` sets the wavenumber K in ρ(x,z) = −sin(π·z)·cos(K·π·x). The actual density + viscosity prescription is performed in §4.2's `SolKzGmgEquivalence.cpp` via `SetDensity` / `SetPhase` callbacks — the `.txt` only carries the parameters; no new `SETS/SolKz.c` setup file is required.)*
